## Site identity
CLOC (CommercialLineOfCredit.com) is an independent educational platform. It is not a bank, lender, or broker.
Content covers commercial line of credit structures, qualification factors, costs, and business financing concepts for U.S. businesses.
No invented rates, lender names, or fabricated statistics are used.
